question: Which complete upstream heads and MLPs causally generate the paired normalized inputs consumed by the exact MLP12/13/15/16/17 bilinear tensor program, and do tensor-contracted incidences predict their downstream mode effects?
novelty: The earlier upstream atlas patched only 30 sites in layers 6/7/9 into the L11H3 input and final modes. This atlas patches the complete 179-site native upstream population and simultaneously captures the left/right inputs and outputs of all five validated downstream MLPs. Each observed MLP change is decomposed exactly through checkpoint Left/Right/Down weights into left, right, and bilinear-interaction terms; this is causal activation-conditioned weight incidence, not a raw-weight rank.

population.rows: The same 24 fresh temporal-v13 rows and 30 is/was-v12 replay-control rows used by the validated literal tensor program.
population.upstream_sites: All 162 attention heads L0H0 through L17H8 and all 17 MLP outputs MLP0 through MLP16. A site is scored only for selected MLP targets that occur later in execution order; same-layer attention precedes its MLP.
population.patch: Replace one complete site's base response with its aligned donor response at every causal-prefix position through the semantic query, then allow every later component to recompute.

measurements.input_generation: For each compatible upstream-site/target-MLP pair, capture changes in the target MLP's normalized Left and Right projections.
measurements.exact_local_tensor: Compute Down[(delta Left) Right0 + Left0 (delta Right) + (delta Left)(delta Right)] and compare with the observed target-MLP output change.
measurements.mode_incidence: Contract each exact factor output through the frozen physical two-mode reader and later residual gain, preserving signed task-by-mode incidence.
measurements.causal_outcome: Measure the upstream patch's final behavior and physical two-mode response with later modules recomputed.
measurements.ranking_test: Compare summed absolute tensor incidence across the five MLP targets with final causal mode magnitude over all 179 sites and report complete rankings plus known-writer enrichment.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_self_patch_fi: Authorities and populations close; all base/donor response shapes align; the joint base self-patch changes selected inputs, outputs, final state, and logits by at most 1e-4; all values are finite and price closes.
predictions.pred_b_all_compatible_local_tensor_expan: Every compatible site-target local expansion has relative squared error at most 1e-8 and max-absolute/output-norm at most 1e-6.
predictions.pred_c_known_writer_frontier_is_enriched: At least three of L7H8, L9H1, L9H4, MLP7, and MLP9 occur in the top 20 sites by tensor-contracted two-mode incidence and each has positive final causal projection in at least one task-mode cell.
predictions.pred_d_tensor_incidence_predicts_final_c: Across all sites, Spearman correlation between tensor-incidence magnitude and final two-mode causal magnitude is at least 0.35, and top-quintile mean causal magnitude is at least twice bottom-quintile mean.
predictions.pred_e_factor_and_target_structure_is_no: At least two target MLPs receive material incidence from distinct top-five upstream writers, and at least one top-20 site has a bilinear-interaction contribution of at least 10% of its total absolute tensor incidence.

terminal_policy.causal_incidence_only: A-C pass but D or E fails
terminal_policy.upstream_tensor_null: valid instrument but known frontier is not enriched

decision: A positive atlas licenses a separately registered greedy combination/removal test. It does not itself establish that the 179 native sites are irreducible semantic units.
